title: Bracket Integrity
description: Determine whether a string containing parentheses, square brackets and curly brackets is properly balanced and correctly nested.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 100000; the string contains only bracket characters.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: the bracket string.
outputFormat: Print YES if every opening bracket is correctly closed, otherwise print NO.
hints: Store opening brackets and compare each closing bracket with the most recent opening bracket.

examples.explanation: Every opening bracket has the correct closing bracket in the proper order.
The closing brackets do not match the required nesting order.
